title: Homelessness Awareness Month.
bodyText: The month of November shall be known and designated as "Homelessness Awareness Month" to promote public awareness of homelessness as a significant societal, public health and welfare, and public housing shortage problem. This month is not and shall not be construed as a state holiday.
bodyHtml: [§8-23]  Homelessness Awareness Month.  The month of November shall be known and designated as "Homelessness Awareness Month" to promote public awareness of homelessness as a significant societal, public health and welfare, and public housing shortage problem.  This month is not and shall not be construed as a state holiday. [L 2013, c 50, §1]
